scope: Actual app state functions with a test DOM and deterministic loader/renderer mocks. No browser UI or frame-rate claim.
checks: Preview then background refinement retain the visible viewer and Tissue / space.
An older original-scan request respects a newer Clean scan selection.
Changing scan resolution during original restoration keeps the newest resolution and cleanup intent.
A failed original load preserves the usable clean volume and reports the failure.
Flow entry is awaitable; returning restores reconstruction framing while preserving material and surface choices.
Viewed Ultra requests start immediately, canceled prior requests cannot win, and all visible source indices are passed to the scheduler.
Warm-cache sections apply synchronously, duplicate cap uploads are avoided, and irrelevant prefetch results stay off screen.
Probe entry is awaitable; module switches stop obsolete section work and preserve shared appearance while restoring reconstruction framing.
